trickyParts: The sweep's delete fence: the informer's snapshot and the pod turn are not one read; since ensureSandbox relabels a suspended Sandbox in place (same UID), only {UID, ResourceVersion} tells a re-admitted issue's Sandbox from the orphan the decision saw, and the relabel patch bumps the version
A gone-wait in bash: `[ -z "$(cmd)" ]` discards cmd's status under `set -e` inside a command substitution; the script's own pattern `out=$(cmd) && [ -z "$out" ]` is what every such wait must use
The probe pod's qosClass is set at creation by the API server, so a poll started before ProbeImage reads it in any phase; the pod lives until ProbeImage deletes the Sandbox
The volume template name changes from `tree` to `issue` for the controller's Sandbox too (PVC issue-legion-<project>-controller)
A releasing IssueSuspend waits until every stored claim of the issue is retired, since issue_close drops each claim's session and IssueHasSessions decides whether workspace-init expects a clone
gVisor exposes no cgroup files: the in-pod checks are nproc == max(2, ceil(sum cpu limits)) and MemTotal within 3% of the summed memory limits
